title: An event injected directly from a channel whose provider has a name carries no provider when its call names none
notes: The agent's AI channel wraps its scripted model, whose name (model.provider, 'scripted' by default) is the channel's provider_name in both implementations. §5.2 asks a provider only of what a provider or backend received, and §10.5 names the event's source as the channel the call names: the injected event carries the provider its call names, none when it names none, as Python's send_event writes it (core/framework.py _direct_source). roomkit-rs wrote the channel's provider_name there before RMK-2191 ('scripted' is present). Not observed: the channel's provider_name itself (RK-6.1-016), which no step reads.
